published_value.explain: Form 1040 line 9 (Total income) adds Total amount from Form(s) W-2, box 1, Taxable interest, Ordinary dividends, Capital gain or (loss), Additional income from Schedule 1, Taxable IRA distributions, and Taxable Social Security benefits.

computed_zero.explain: Form 1040 line 9 (Total income) is zero because those amounts come to zero.

closure_backed_zero.explain: Form 1040 line 9 (Total income) is zero because nothing was recorded and that record is complete.

blocked.explain: Form 1040 line 9 (Total income) has no value yet. It is waiting for the amounts it adds.

guard_inapplicable.explain: Form 1040 line 9 (Total income) has no condition that turns it off, so this sentence is not shown.
